nodes.name: Receive health.json
nodes.notes: Production URL: https://n8n.kjnet.us/webhook/indienodes-member-health -- the value member-health-scheduled.yml's resume_url input is set to by the dispatcher workflow. Responds immediately: the GitHub job fire-and-forgets this POST and never reads the response, so there is no reason to hold its connection open through the Gotify chain. This workflow must be published for the production URL to be live.

nodes.name: Track streaks
nodes.notes: Replaces check-member-links.js's --state file: 3 consecutive 'broken' results for the same URL crosses the alert threshold, any healthy/warning result resets it. State lives in this workflow's own static data, persisted by n8n across executions -- so the streak history belongs to this receiver workflow, not the dispatcher.

nodes.name: Alert via Gotify
nodes.notes: Credential: Gotify API. Set 'URL' to your Gotify host and 'App API Token' to an application token from Gotify's Apps tab — the client token field can stay empty, it's only needed for delete/list operations this workflow doesn't use.
